channel.title: Transmission Remote Updates
channel.description: Transmission Remote macOS app update feed

item.description:
• Add Sparkle 2.x in-app auto-updater
  • Persist detail tab selection and Files column widths across launches
  • Color file progress bars green at 100%, accent otherwise

• Add Copy Name / Copy Remote Path actions and ⌘⇧M for Move
  • Show one decimal place on progress % when the column is wide enough

• Wire up double-click to open in the Files tab
  • Fix Sparkle download URLs: GitHub sanitizes spaces to dots in asset names
• Stop full reloadData() on every poll disrupting double-click

• Reformat asset catalog JSON and unwrap a CLAUDE.md line
  • Fix reconnect-endpoint ambiguity and spinner flicker in RefreshController
  • Add Browse… button to Move dialog with remote path reverse-mapping
  • Remove hard wrapping from markdown files via oxfmt
  • Disable hard wrapping for markdown files in .editorconfig

• Screenshots for readme
  • Fix .torrent opened at cold launch being dropped before the window loads

• Revert drag-out to plain file URLs, restoring Finder's native copy progress
  • Switch drag-out to a file promise, and warn when a file's own permissions will block it
  • Warn on drag-out attempts that would produce nothing, and unify remote-path resolution
  • Tighten Settings layout: smaller General/divider gap, flush-left auto-update checkbox, add/remove buttons bottom-aligned with Test/Save row
  • Fix path-mapping resolution to use longest prefix, not list order
  • Actually fix drag-out to Finder: override sourceOperationMaskFor, not just the setter
  • Reorder Settings window: General first, then a Server Settings section with Test/Save Server anchored below the form
  • Replace Settings tabs with always-visible Servers/General panes, right-size the server list to match the detail form
  • Fix drag-out to Finder: table views never granted an outside-app drag mask
  • Make Cancel the default button on the Remove confirmation sheet
  • Fix beachball on Space: Quick Look responder-chain splice caused an infinite loop
  • Fix Quick Look: checkbox stole Space in Files tab, silent no-op in list view
  • Add Quick Look (Space) for the resolved local file in both tables
  • Close three accessibility gaps: toast announcements, Reduce Motion, progress bar value
  • Persist Settings window position across opens
  • Add Copy Magnet Link to the torrent context menu
  • Support dragging a torrent/file row out to Finder as a copy
  • Bind Delete/Backspace to Remove in the torrent table
  • Fix make dev opening two app copies from stale DerivedData dirs
  • Add auto-check-for-updates preference with first-run prompt

• Give the live client a real operational timeout instead of the probe timeout
  • Rewrite the 2026.07.08.1 changelog section as user-facing feature bullets
• Add a "move data" checkbox to the Move Torrent sheet

• Always show the active server name in the window title
  • Add Help menu with searchable menu items and GitHub link
  • Add Reannounce action and DRY up simple per-selection RPC actions
  • Fix Move Torrent to move all selected torrents, not just the first

• Broaden RecentFolders test coverage; fix whitespace-only entry leak
  • Share destination-folder history between Add and Move dialogs
  • Remember recently-used destination folders when adding torrents
  • Add Seeds and Peers columns to the main torrent list
  • Show real recheck progress instead of stale percentDone while checking
  • Refactor README.md for improved formatting
  • Auto-document zip SHA256 and code signature in release notes
• Fix concurrency/correctness bugs; add Docker Transmission test fixture

• Collapse remove-torrent-file setting to a single 3-way choice
  • Add option to remove .torrent files after adding (#10)
• Add magnet/torrent link handling, clipboard pickup, and default-app registration (#11)

• Add AppleScript support for torrents, preferences, and menu actions
  • Settings polish: no reconnect on General edits, General tab first, clearer handler labels
  • Split Settings into Servers/General tabs; fix cross-pane dirty bug
  • Accept smb:// URLs as path-mapping targets (issue #12)

• compress replacement dock icon
  • Show the classic freeform icon in the Dock and Finder (escape squircle jail)
  • Update server menu items in-place when the server list is unchanged
  • Add AppleScript-driven test coverage and test-isolation launch hook

• Files sort: extract testable TorrentFileSort, add unsorted third click, fix stale comment
  • Make Files tab columns sortable (#14)
  • lossless compress other image files

• Sync toolbar display mode with layout, drop tabbing, clear sidebar on server switch
  • Address PR #15 review: DRY popup/layout logic, View menu, drop retargeting, tests
  • Document title bar, toolbar layout, and server UX
  • Use outline symbols for toolbar actions
  • Add View menu with toolbar size options
  • Add title bar server dropdown and toolbar size
  • Add ⌘1–⌘0 shortcuts for switching servers
  • Allow reordering servers in Settings
  • Add Manage Servers… to the Server menu

• Open Settings on the Servers tab on first launch
  • Split title bar and button labels, fix toolbar search and server item bugs
• remove view settings from settings screen, control them from view menu or toolbar

• Detail tabs: tick tracker countdown, share header sort cycle with Files, order overlapping file fetches
  • Trackers/Peers tabs: extract cell text, sort cycle and reselect helpers; add tests
  • Trackers tab: sortable per-tracker status table in the detail pane (#17)
  • Files tab: handle header-click sorting via the NSOutlineView data-source method
  • Files tab: expand all top-level folders, folders-first setting, Name sort toggles A-Z/Z-A
  • Files tree lists folders before files when sorted; Peers tab shows peer count
  • Peers tab: sortable peer table in the detail pane (Info/Files/Peers)
  • Files tab: directory-tree view (NSOutlineView)

• Piece map: add Settings > General toggle (showPieceMap), tests for gate and checkbox
  • Bound TorrentPieces.pieceCount by the bitfield to prevent a hostile-daemon hang
  • Info tab: add piece map row (classic bar + per-piece map), port of legacy pbDownloaded

• Notarize: strip AppleDouble entries from release zip
  • Add one-sentence release summary to GitHub release notes

Free space now shows for the folder you're viewing, not just the default download folder; update dialogs lead with this release's summary.

  • Show free space for the folder in view, not just the default dir (#20)
  • Show release summary at top of Sparkle update dialog
  • Appcast: update signatures/lengths for re-uploaded clean release zips

Adds a sortable Uploaded column to the torrent list, so you can sort torrents by how much data you've uploaded.

  • Add sortable Uploaded column (#21)

Adds a speed-limit control and a global speed readout, so you can set download and upload limits and see current transfer speeds at a glance.

  • Add speed-limit control and global speed readout

The status-bar speed graph now has labels, and clicking it opens the speed limits menu.

  • Label the status-bar speed graph and open the speed menu on click

Settings is now one window: a sidebar lists General and each server, with per-server tabs, Apply and Revert, and bandwidth groups.

  • Settings bug-bash fixes: port validation, id-keyed state, safer saves
  • Settings: equal-height footer buttons, Default on the trailing edge
  • Settings: text Default button; explain the .torrent deletion setting
  • Settings: Make Default button, Test Connection in the form, one Revert
  • Never reset Settings over unsaved edits on reopen
  • Document the unified Settings window
  • Keep the active server across a rename
  • Unify Settings: sidebar with General and per-server tabs
  • Add settings tiers, per-server saving and the apply plan
  • Give each server a stable id
  • Add Server Options window and bandwidth groups
  • Polish native toolbar customization and menu updates
  • Add native Server Options and grouped toolbar controls

Adds a sortable Error column to the transfer list and makes the app fetch only the data its visible columns and tabs need.

  • Add sortable Error column to the transfer list (#25)
  • Request only the torrent fields that visible columns and tabs need
  • Make fixture tests real and the fixture gate strict
  • Read live-test credentials from the native preferences store
  • Add live test for the second N5 LAN address
  • Make the N5 LAN-address live test pass when either address answers
  • List release notes oldest-first
